parameters.name: Criteria
parameters.description: The search condition for the image baseline.

parameters.name: CriteriaType
parameters.description:
The type of the search condition. Valid values:

*   **BaselineNameAlias**: baseline name
*   **BaselineClassAlias**: baseline category

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description:
The severity of the image baseline that you want to query. Separate multiple severities with commas (,). By default, all valid values are used. Valid values:

*   **high**
*   **medium**
*   **low**

parameters.name: ScanRange
parameters.description: The types of the assets that you want to scan.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-image-baseline-check-result --image-uuid a910053dd4710173ecc9e9d8931f0000 --risk-level high,medium,low --criteria ak_leak --criteria-type BaselineNameAlias --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --lang zh --scan-range image --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeImageBaselineCheckResult --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --CriteriaType BaselineNameAlias --Lang zh --Criteria ak_leak --ScanRange.1 image --ImageUuid a910053dd4710173ecc9e9d8931f0000 --RiskLevel 'high,medium,low'
